record.title: Reconcile physical cached identity evidence and the next offline comparison
record.intent: Separate physical permission and observed values from later offline identity and private-state inference.
requirements: Evaluate capture quality, process/file identity, permissions and sample consistency independently. Do not treat repeated samples as atomic or cached values as complete private state.

If the observation succeeds, propose or admit only bounded offline stock derivation and acquired-Key.data coherence comparison. If it fails, preserve the exact limitation without automatic privilege or interface escalation.
Commit and push the result and decision. Physical entitlement installation, capability transition, reboot, calibration and additional state acquisition remain separate authorization events.
acceptance: The observation and next bounded action are explicitly reconciled without an unapproved physical transition.
